build_trackhead_module: build a TrackHead module with DPT feature extractor and BaseTrackerPredictor for iterative point tracking
create_trackhead_with_config: create a TrackHead instance with custom dim_in, patch_size, features, iters, and correlation parameters
run_trackhead_forward: run the TrackHead forward pass with aggregated tokens, images, and query points to get coordinate predictions

summarize_trackhead_forward: summarize the TrackHead forward pass that extracts features then predicts coordinates, visibility, and confidence scores
